newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was slow in the Panhandle area late Wednesday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed steady to weak.

Feedlots reported moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 7,400 slaughter steers and 900 heifers; 86,600 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 8 loads or 300 head CME cattle delivered to area packing plants, 13,800 head formulated and 300 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 67.50 to mostly 68.00. Pen select, few choice 2-3 1200 lbs 67.00.
Wk to date: 86,600 Week Ago: 97,600 Year Ago: 66,600
